name: manual_a2d93b
claim: When a merge conflicts in the append-only memory ledgers, keep the target branch's bytes as an exact prefix including pre-existing duplicate lines, append only the branch's new rows, and regenerate LESSONS.md with render_lessons instead of merging it by hand; take newer dependency manifests and lockfiles from main when the branch never changed them.

decisions.notes: Supersedes the line-union guidance: the repo's episodic append-only check requires the target branch's bytes as an exact prefix, duplicates included, and LESSONS.md is rendered from lessons.jsonl and never merged by hand.

rationale: Supersedes the line-union guidance: the repo's episodic append-only check requires the target branch's bytes as an exact prefix, duplicates included, and LESSONS.md is rendered from lessons.jsonl and never merged by hand.
